text:
Priya: heads up — p95 for /v1/generate jumped ~80ms after quota fallback last night. console endpoint p95 looks steady but route-level p95 is up. anyone seen this pattern before?
Tom: seeing it in the rollup too. suspect fallback routing to the n2-small model plus queueing. route rollup mixes samples from gateway + backend, maybe weights shifted. :thinking:
Aisha: last time this happened it was sample-origin blending. our rollup t-digest is computed after merging different sample sources without exposing provenance. that masks the per-origin distribution.
Sam: agree. console currently only shows combined t-digest and sample_count. ops can't tell whether the tail is from gateway retries, quota fallbacks, or backend.
Jorge: quick question — do we want console to show separate percentiles by sample_origin (gateway/backend/fallback-model)? or surface an explanation badge that p95 may be influenced by fallback weight?
Priya: both would help. immediate: a provenance badge + link to a breakdown drilldown. long term: per-origin percentiles.
Tom: implementation note: our internal telemetry API returns either raw samples (heavy) or tdigest blobs. Adding per-origin tdigest is easiest perf-wise. returning raw samples is a hard no for prod.
Aisha: per-origin tdigest + counts works. but UI needs to avoid implying exactness — we should annotate that merged pctl != weighted pctl of origins unless we do a proper merge algorithm.
Sam: UI suggestion: toggle labeled "Show sample origins" that overlays small sparklines for gateway/backend/fallback and shows counts. also include a small explainer: "p95 shown above is from merged t-digest; toggle to see origin-specific tdigest estimates."
Jorge: API proposal draft: 
```
GET /v1/telemetry/percentiles?endpoint=/v1/generate&window=5m
{
  "merged_tdigest": "base64...",
  "origins": [
    {"name": "gateway", "tdigest": "base64...", "count": 1234},
    {"name": "backend", "tdigest": "base64...", "count": 987}
  ]
}
```
This keeps payload small and avoids raw-sample export.
Tom: that looks fine. small caveat: we need to ensure t-digest compression params are consistent across origins so merges are meaningful. add compression param in metadata.
Aisha: question for eng-platform: will adding per-origin tdigest increase ingest CPU or storage? we only store tdigest rollups, not raw samples. should be minor but we need to check rollup job CPU.
Priya: ops: last night quota fallback had 30% weight to fallback pool between 03:12–03:40. if we had origin breakouts we'd have caught the correlation faster.
Sam: small UX edgecase: when total count is low, origin percentiles will be noisy. UI should gray out per-origin pctl when count < 50 and show sample_count.
Jorge: also need to consider routing policies: adaptive routing changes weights quickly; origin counts can swing and then merged pctl moves. we should timestamp origin weight changes in rollout logs and link from console.
observability-bot: new metric collected: rollout_weight_changes (timestamped). added to infra telemetry stream. :white_check_mark:
Priya: next steps: 1) Aisha run perf estimate for adding per-origin tdigest to rollups (responsible: Aisha) 2) Tom spec API with compression param and examples (responsible: Tom) 3) UX: Sam to mock toggle + explainer copy (responsible: Sam) 4) Jorge to add quick link from rollout page to endpoint telemetry (responsible: Jorge)
Aisha: will run perf check today and report numbers here.
Tom: I'll sketch the API proto and post a followup in this thread.
Sam: will mock in FigJam and drop screenshots.
Jorge: I'll instrument rollout change links.
Priya: thanks team — this should reduce our mean time to explain for pctl incidents. :pray:
